curatedMovie.curiosityHook: Cut off from their Evangelions on a ruined world, can the pilots withstand the final cataclysm gathering on the horizon?
curatedMovie.description: After the Fourth Impact ravages Earth, Shinji, Asuka, and Rei find shelter in a rare refuge of surviving humans, navigating quiet daily lives until a looming catastrophe threatens what remains.
curatedMovie.vibeSummary: Heavy, urgent, and deeply immersive anime sci-fi built for concentrated solo viewing.
curatedMovie.whyWatch: Directed by Hideaki Anno, Kazuya Tsurumaki, Mahiro Maeda, and Katsuichi Nakayama, this anime epic pairs intimate post-apocalyptic drama with sweeping, urgent sci-fi spectacle.

facts.director: Kazuya Tsurumaki & Mahiro Maeda & Katsuichi Nakayama & Hideaki Anno
facts.title: Evangelion: 3.0+1.0 Thrice Upon a Time
